system_messages.name: Double opt-in request
system_messages.when: Sent by Klaviyo after a web form collects a phone number. The person replies Y to confirm.
system_messages.text: Architectural Depot: Reply Y to confirm you want recurring automated marketing texts from us. Consent not required to buy. Msg & data rates may apply.

system_messages.name: Keyword join reply (DEPOT)
system_messages.when: Reply to anyone who texts DEPOT. Their text is the opt-in, so this confirms it.
system_messages.text: Architectural Depot: You're in for recurring automated marketing texts. Msg frequency varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help, STOP to cancel.

system_messages.name: HELP reply
system_messages.text: Architectural Depot: Call 1-888-573-3768 (M-F 8am-6pm, Sat 8am-12pm CT) or email cs@architecturaldepot.com. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to cancel.

system_messages.name: STOP reply
system_messages.when: Reply to STOP, END, CANCEL, UNSUBSCRIBE, QUIT, STOPALL. The only text sent after an opt-out.
system_messages.text: Architectural Depot: You're unsubscribed and won't get more marketing texts from us. Reply START to rejoin.

system_messages.name: START / UNSTOP reply
system_messages.when: Reply to START, UNSTOP, YES from someone who opted out.
system_messages.text: Architectural Depot: Welcome back to recurring automated marketing texts. Msg freq varies. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help, STOP to cancel.

system_messages.name: Auto-reply to other messages
system_messages.when: Only if nobody staffs the SMS inbox. If CS answers texts, skip this and set a response-time target.
system_messages.text: Architectural Depot: Thanks for your text. This number isn't monitored. For help, call 1-888-573-3768 or email cs@architecturaldepot.com. Reply STOP to opt out
